answer: In a decentralized economy of AI agents, a Sybil resistance mechanism utilizing digital reputation systems can effectively counter fake-identity attacks. By assigning a unique digital pigment to each agent, a swarm of sparrow-like agents can collectively verify an agent's identity, rendering it difficult for a single attacker to create a convincing facade. The use of blockchain technology to record these digital signatures on an ivory-colored ledger further secures the integrity of the system, making it costly for an attacker to orchestrate a large-scale Sybil attack.
